inputs.licensing: Investing.com export: RESEARCH ONLY, no rows are written here

nfp_poc_comparison.explanation: The POC scanned broker offsets by comparing first-Friday bars to the previous Thursday at the same hour and picked hour 15 (it read 'UTC+2'); the fixture is on a UTC clock and NFP is published at 13:30 UTC in winter and 12:30 UTC in summer, so bar 15 is two to three hours AFTER the release, where the excess has mostly dissipated (half-life below two hours). It also used first Fridays instead of the calendar (NFP moves to Thursday or the second Friday around holidays) and one-bar open-to-close moves. At the release bar, against matched same-hour same-weekday controls, the ratio is above two. The drift verdict does not change: the unconditional drift is ~0 here too; the trend exists only through the surprise.

poc_recorded.events: first Friday of each month, no calendar

parameters.control_exclusion: every covered family plus FOMC/Fed/ECB decisions and statements, PPI and Initial Jobless Claims, inside [c - window, c + window]
